default.notes: Not on Hong Kong's visa-waiver list — apply to the Immigration Department for an entry visa before travel; applications generally need a local sponsor.

groups.notes: British citizens may visit Hong Kong visa-free for up to 180 days.
Visa-free for up to 90 days as a visitor — no visa or registration needed for tourism.
Visa-free for up to 30 days as a visitor — confirm your exact allowance on the Immigration Department's visa-free list before a long stay.
Visa-free for up to 14 days as a visitor.

HK.notes: Home territory — no entry requirements for Hong Kong permanent residents.

CN.notes: Mainland Chinese citizens do not use a Hong Kong visa — travel is on a Mainland Travel Permit with an exit endorsement issued by mainland public-security authorities.

MO.notes: Macao residents enter freely — most use their Macao permanent identity card or visit permit rather than the SAR passport; confirm the exact stay allowance with the Immigration Department.

IN.notes: Indian nationals must complete the free online Pre-arrival Registration before boarding — valid 6 months for multiple visits of up to 14 days each.

TW.notes: Taiwan residents pre-register online free of charge before travel — up to 30 days per visit.

VA.notes: Holy See passport holders may visit visa-free for a short stay, commonly cited as 14 days — confirm with the Immigration Department.

XK.notes: Kosovo passports are not on the visa-waiver list — contact the Immigration Department or a Chinese mission about entry-visa arrangements before travel.
